Provincial Council Notifications
NORTH WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL

Amendment of Section 13, 15 (1) and 15 (2) of Establishing and Regularizing of Community BasedOrganizations ( Water Supply and Environmental Sanitation) Statute No.01 of 2013 of the Provincial Council
of North Western Province

I, do hereby notify the amendment to Establishing and Regularizing of Community Based Organizations (WaterSupply and Environmental Sanitation) Statute No.01 of 2013 of the Provincial Council of North Western Province,publishedhereunder will be presented in the Provincial Council of North Western Province of the expiry of thirty days from thedate of its publication in this Gazette.Any person who wishes to make any representation regarding any of the provisionsof the statute, shall forward the same to me within the said period of thirty days.
D.G. B.M. DHARMASIRI DASANAYAKE,

Establishing and Regularizing of Community Based Organizations (Water Supply and Environmental Sanitation) StatuteNo.01 of 2013 of the Provincial Council of North Western Province.

The amendment of Section 13, 15 (1) and 15 (2) of Establishing and Regularizing of Community Based Organizations(Water Supply and Environmental Sanitation) Statute No.01 of 2013 of the Provincial Council of North Western Province.

Be it enacted by the Provincial Council of North Western Province by virtue of the powers vested in the saidProvincial Council, by article No.28 in the 1st (Provincial Council) List in Schedule 9 in the Constitution of DemocraticSocialist Republic of Sri Lanka.

The composition of the Provincial Committee is hereby amended by repeal of the paragraph “The directorsof the Department of Roads and Department of Highways of North Western Province” and the paragraph“The Secretaries of Local Government bodies who operate drinking water supply and sanitation projects”specified respectively under serial No. 11 and 12 in Section 13 of the statute.

The Section 15 (1) is hereby amended by substitution of the word “once in six (06) months” for “oncein two (2) months” and substitution of the word “ meetings and extra persons” for “ extra meetings”.
The Section 15 (2) is hereby amended by substitution of the word “eight members” for “ten members”.
